LanguageData.SDS_ImplantA.label: Super Dimensional Basic Chip
LanguageData.SDS_ImplantA.description: An implant (basic model) that lets a colonist link to super dimensional storage. Once implanted, the colonist can access the stored stock at any time on a map that has a super dimensional core.
LanguageData.SDS_ImplantB.label: Super Dimensional Advanced Chip
LanguageData.SDS_ImplantB.description: An implant (advanced model) that lets a colonist link to super dimensional storage. Once implanted, the colonist can access the stored stock across maps at any time.
